input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position in full: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or to a successor by merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets (24.1); Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a direct competitor (24.2); other assignments are subject to a mutual reasonable-consent standard (24.3); and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on our change of control. Section 13 (p0056) reinforces licence transfer to a permitted successor, and no residual assignment restriction appears in § 30 or elsewhere. No redline needed.
